WITH LocalFundedSchools AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM schools
    WHERE FundingType = 'Local'
),
Differences AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.DOC,
        s.DOCType,
        s.School,
        (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS Difference
    FROM LocalFundedSchools s
)
SELECT 
    d.CDSCode,
    d.DOC,
    d.DOCType,
    d.School,
    AVG(d.Difference) AS AvgDifference
FROM Differences d
GROUP BY d.CDSCode, d.DOC, d.DOCType, d.School
HAVING AvgDifference > (SELECT AVG(Difference) FROM Differences)	----- bird -----	california_schools

        p.height,
        pa.finishing

WITH min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        Segment
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
min_segment AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM min_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
sme_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
lam_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
kam_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
sme_avg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS SMEAverag
    FROM sme_consumption
),
lam_avg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS LAMAverag
    FROM lam_consumption
),
kam_avg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS KAMAverag
    FROM kam_consumption
),
sme_lam_diff AS (
    SELECT
        (sme_avg.SMEAverag - lam_avg.LAMAverag) AS DiffSMEtoLAM
    FROM sme_avg, lam_avg
),
lam_kam_diff AS (
    SELECT
        (lam_avg.LAMAverag - kam_avg.KAMAverag) AS DiffLAMtoKAM
    FROM lam_avg, kam_avg
),
kam_sme_diff AS (
    SELECT
        (kam_avg.KAMAverag - sme_avg.SMEAverag) AS DiffKAMtoSME
    FROM kam_avg, sme_avg
)
SELECT
    DiffSMEtoLAM AS "Difference SME to LAM",
    DiffLAMtoKAM AS "Difference LAM to KAM",
    DiffKAMtoSME AS "Difference KAM to SME"
FROM sme_lam_diff, lam_kam_diff, kam_sme_diff	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS Consumption2012
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS Consumption2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT c2013.CustomerID, 
           (c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
           ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2013.Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM consumption_2013 c2013
    JOIN consumption_2012 c2012 ON c2013.CustomerID = c2012.CustomerID
),
segment_percentage AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, AVG(pi.PercentageIncrease) AS AvgPercentageIncrease
    FROM percentage_increase pi
    JOIN customers c ON pi.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN products p ON c.CustomerID = p.ProductID
    WHERE p.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, AvgPercentageIncrease
FROM segment_percentage
ORDER BY AvgPercentageIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
